In mathematics, a '''Marot ring''' ({{IPAc-en|lang|m|ɑː|ˈ|r|oʊ}} {{Respell|mah-ROH}}, {{IPA|fr|maʁo|lang}}), introduced by {{harvtxt|Marot|1969}},{{r|marot}} is a commutative ring whose [[regular ideal]]s are generated by regular elements.{{r|matsuda}}
